data.name: TF-IDF with Isolation Forest
data.research_question: Does a sparse lexical representation with Isolation Forest provide a competitive anomaly baseline?
data.hypothesis: TF-IDF captures token-level rarity but will struggle with semantically equivalent descriptions.
data.representation: TF-IDF over 1-2 word n-grams of the V2 description
data.training_strategy: Fit vectoriser and Isolation Forest on 99,665 benign training events only.
data.results_summary: ROC-AUC 0.671003 and Average Precision 0.001274. At the P99 validation threshold, zero original positives and 1,445 false positives were flagged.
data.interpretation: Lexical rarity is a poor proxy for malicious semantics in this representation; ranking is only modestly above chance.
data.limitations: TF-IDF ignores word order and semantic similarity, and max_features truncates the vocabulary.
